description: This file defines a React hook 'useProgressiveExpand' and a utility function 'createProgressiveExpandController' for managing batch processing tasks in a non-blocking, progressive manner. It handles applying work in batches, tracking progress, and integrating with React component state.

methods.name: createProgressiveExpandController
methods.description: Creates a controller object to manage progressive batch processing with support for requestIdleCallback or setTimeout fallback, including start and cancel methods, and progress tracking.

methods.name: useProgressiveExpand
methods.description: A React hook that wraps the controller to manage UI state (running, progress, counts) for progressive batch processing, providing start and cancel functions.
